integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] A photoreal street-racing night scene in Tokyo opens low and wide on a turbocharged wide-body hot hatch blasting through a wet expressway lane, sodium lights streaking across its flared fenders. The camera tracks inches above the asphalt beside the car as the turbo spools, the driver snaps a shift, and blue reflections from overhead signs slide across the windshield; halfway through, the car dives under an overpass and the camera arcs slightly behind to reveal the aggressive rear wing and a brief flame popping from the exhaust before it disappears into the neon distance.

overall_soundscape: Tire hiss on damp pavement, rising turbo whine, sharp gear-change clacks, and a deep exhaust note bounce off concrete walls. Passing traffic rushes by in the far lanes and the city hum stays constant underneath.

non_diegetic_music: N/A

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] A realistic office workshop scene begins in a medium shot on a 31-year-old engineer in a tense blue dress layered over pale blue tights, standing under cool fluorescent lights at a cluttered electronics bench. She turns a circuit board over in both hands, squints at a blinking component, presses one button with growing uncertainty, then looks around in confusion as the camera slowly pushes in; at 00:05.000 a tiny spark jumps from the board, she jerks back, half-laughing in disbelief, and holds the board away from herself while the diagnostic LEDs keep flashing.

overall_soundscape: Air conditioning hum, light tool clinks, servo clicks from nearby equipment, and the dry plastic tap of the circuit board against the bench fill the room. The small electrical snap lands sharply, followed by her quick startled breath.

non_diegetic_music: N/A

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] A mythic live-action fantasy tableau opens on a storm-wrapped mountain summit where Zeus, rendered as an original thunder god with bronze armor and a weathered face, stands at the edge of a shattered marble platform. The camera slowly pushes toward his eyes as forked lightning flickers behind him, revealing determination and hope in his expression while he tightens his grip on a glowing thunderbolt. [Shot 2] At 00:05.500, the view widens as a colossal shadow rises within the cloud wall ahead; he plants his feet, lifts the weapon toward the oncoming darkness, and a ring of blue-white electricity races outward across the broken stone as the confrontation is about to begin.

overall_soundscape: Wind tears across the summit, thunder rolls from multiple directions, and loose gravel skitters over cracked marble. Electric crackles intensify around the weapon until the final burst snaps through the air.

non_diegetic_music: Low male choir, distant taiko-style drums, and swelling brass build from restrained tension to a bright heroic surge in the final seconds.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] A stylized cinematic fantasy shot opens in a misty bamboo forest on a towering panda warrior in engraved armor, framed from a low angle with broken shafts of sunlight cutting through green leaves. The camera trucks forward as the warrior lifts a battle axe overhead, throws back its head, and roars in victory while strips of red cloth tied to the armor whip in the breeze; the shot ends with birds exploding out of the bamboo canopy behind it.

overall_soundscape: Bamboo stalks creak softly, leaves hiss in the wind, and distant birds scatter as the armored figure shifts its weight. The victory roar dominates the clearing and echoes through the forest.

non_diegetic_music: N/A
